_comment: Tier-2 for febio, SYNTHETIC index 99 (no pitfall claim): FEBio backend self-consistency gate. Pins INTERNAL consistency: (a) every PhysicsCapability in supported_physics() has a matching _TEMPLATES['<physics>_<variant>'] entry — generate_input() must not raise ValueError for advertised physics × variants; (b) every PhysicsCapability has a _FEBIO_KNOWLEDGE['<physics>'] entry — get_knowledge() must not return {}; (c) every shipped template emits well-formed XML with <febio_spec version='4.0'> root; (d) every template's <Module type='X'> matches the physics-required module. Catalog falsifications #29 + #30: the previous backend advertised 4 physics but had 1 template + 2 knowledge entries — 3 ValueError paths + 2 empty-dict get_knowledge paths. Fix shipped alongside (3 template stubs + 2 knowledge entries). Verified 2026-06-01. AUDIT PASS 5 (2026-08-03, first pass with FEBio actually installed): three staleness bugs fixed (missing core.backend.sorted_by_step stub; elasticity_mms absent from PHYSICS_TO_MODULE; a new pinned observable templates_with_unregistered_module). AUDIT PASS 6 (2026-08-05, adversarial): pass 5 PINNED THE DEFECT. It asserted templates_with_unregistered_module=['biphasic_fsi_3d_block', 'heat_3d_bar'] and mapped biphasic_fsi to a 'biphasic-FSI' module, so the fixture REQUIRED both templates to keep segfaulting FEBio and went red the moment either was repaired. Both were repaired on 2026-08-03 (heat_3d_bar -> thermo-fluid, biphasic_fsi_3d_block -> fluid-FSI module with the biphasic-FSI MATERIAL) and rigid_contact_3d_indentation was added, so at that point this fixture failed with exit 2 while tests/test_febio_source_of_truth.py was green — the inversion was applied to the unit test and not here. Now GATED, not pinned: the offender list must be EMPTY. Do not re-pin an offender; fix the template. RE-KEYED 2026-08-06 from index 0 to the synthetic index 99: this is a backend self-consistency gate, not evidence for any pitfall claim, and while it sat on index 0 it occupied the slot of the real linear_elasticity#0 claim (<material> needs name=, <SolidDomain> cites the NAME) and made that claim look covered when it was not. MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 deletes one shipped template from the in-memory registry. This fixture is a catalog self-consistency gate rather than a pitfall reproduction, so the control shows the gate can fail: the deletion is exactly the inconsistency it exists to catch. Nothing on disk is touched. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectations 'templates_count=18', 'missing_templates=[]' are no longer printed and the forbidden token 'FAIL:' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
